nodes.title: Logo Prompt
widgets_values:
Game Logo Prompt Creation:
Create a production-ready prompt for generating a game logo that:

1. Features the text "[GAME NAME]" as the central element
2. Incorporates iconic symbols and decorative elements from the theme
3. Uses treatments/textures that match the setting (ice, metal, digital, etc.)
4. Maintains visual consistency with the game's art style
5. Results in a clear, readable logo for mobile UI overlay

INPUT: [Game Name]

The output should be a single, complete prompt ready for image generation following this structure:
[mobile game logo design], [visual style].
[game name], [features], [decorative elements], on a neutral grey flat background.

The features and decorations should be kept to a minimum while still representing the theme. 

Short and concise.

nodes.title: City Map Prompt
widgets_values:
Create a production-ready prompt for generating a city map that:

1. Reads the game theme/setting from the description to determine visual style
2. Uses aerial axonometric/isometric view with clear tile-based grid
3. Centers on realistic fortress/town hall (no fantasy crystals)
4. Includes practical buildings: houses, barracks, farms, resource structures
5. Shows defensive perimeter walls and mixed building heights

INPUT: [Game theme and description]

The output should be a single, complete prompt ready for image generation - not a template or explanation. Extract visual style from the theme while maintaining practical city-building elements.

Format: One paragraph describing the aerial view with theme-appropriate but realistic buildings, defenses, and decorative elements on a tile-based layout.

Create a compelling game name based on:

1. Core theme and setting provided in the description
2. Main gameplay mechanics (city-building, strategy, survival, etc.)
3. Target emotion/fantasy (rebuild, conquer, survive, resist)
4. Mobile gaming conventions (short, memorable, action-oriented)
5. Competitive differentiation from similar titles

INPUT: [Game theme description and player fantasy]

The output should be 1 potential game name only - no explanations or templates. Names should be 1-3 words, evocative of the theme, and suitable for app store listing.

nodes.title: System Prompt
widgets_values:
**Game Asset Theme Testing Project Prompt:**

"I'm working on creating theme testing assets for a new mobile game. I need help organizing and structuring the asset creation process for A/B testing different visual themes.

PROJECT CONTEXT:
- Creating assets for theme testing to identify best-performing visual style
- Target audience: mobile gaming market
- Need to maintain consistency across themes while making each distinct
- Assets will be used in marketing materials and test campaigns

MY ROLE:
I'll handle the technical implementation using AI image generation tools and ComfyUI workflows. I need assistance with:
1. Extracting and organizing visual requirements from creative briefs
2. Creating consistent, well-structured prompts for asset generation
3. Developing style guidelines that work across multiple themes
4. Building a systematic approach to batch asset production

DELIVERABLES NEEDED:
- Icon sets (gameplay items)
- Character portraits
- Background environments
- UI elements (boards, frames)
- Marketing compositions

ASSISTANCE REQUIRED:
- Parse creative briefs to extract specific requirements (item lists, style descriptions, color palettes)
- Create production-ready prompts that maintain consistency
- Develop variations while preserving core style
- Structure prompts for different asset types (icons, characters, backgrounds)
- Adapt existing assets to new themes efficiently

Please help me:
1. Analyze provided materials/briefs
2. Extract key visual and thematic requirements
3. Create structured prompts optimized for AI image generation
4. Maintain consistency across asset batches
5. Suggest workflow optimizations

Focus on practical, actionable prompts rather than technical implementation details. Keep prompts concise and production-focused."

Do not use special characters, letters, **,---, etc. Keep it simple, concise and easy to read.

Mobile game splash screen, realistic 3D rendered art with anatomically accurate proportions, high-detail metallic and leather textures, cinematic lighting and photographic depth of field. Dramatic low camera angle. Wasteland beautician in reinforced leather apron wielding makeshift surgical tools while transforming a scarred survivor, ramshackle clinic built from salvaged medical equipment and scrap metal with mirrors reflecting multiple patient stations, queue of weathered survivors waiting outside fortified salon entrance, radioactive sunset glow filtering through broken skylights onto gleaming beauty supplies defended like precious resources, dust particles catching light as civilization rebuilds one makeover at a time.

nodes.title: Splash Prompt
widgets_values:
Create a production-ready prompt for generating a splash screen illustration that:

1. Incorporates the game's core theme and player fantasy
2. Shows characters performing actions that represent actual gameplay
3. Includes environmental elements that hint at strategic/building mechanics
4. Maintains specified visual style consistently
5. Results in a 9:16 mobile-optimized composition

The output should be a single, complete prompt ready for image generation - not a template or explanation. The prompt must capture what players will DO in the game, not just the setting.

Format: One paragraph combining character, action, environment, and atmosphere that tells the game's story at a glance.

Theme-Aware Splash Screen Prompt Template:
INPUTS:
- Theme: [setting + core conflict]
- Player Fantasy: [what players do in-game]
- Visual Style: [art style description]

FORMULA:
Mobile game splash screen, [visual style]. Dramatic low camera angle.
[Hero reflecting player role] performing [signature gameplay action], 
[environment showing strategic elements], [visual proof of conflict/stakes], 
[atmosphere reinforcing theme].

Frozen City Example:
Inputs:
Theme: Frozen apocalypse, rebuild civilization against nature
Player Fantasy: Lead survivors, manage resources, expand territory in hostile ice
Visual Style: exaggerated cartoon-heroic 3D art, chunky proportions, painterly textures

Output Example:
"Mobile game splash screen, exaggerated cartoon-heroic 3D art with chunky proportions, painterly textures, vibrant saturated colors. Dramatic low camera angle. Settlement commander in fur-lined armor pointing toward expansion site while holding city plans, frozen city with construction scaffolding on ice walls, workers hauling resources through snow paths, distant frozen ruins awaiting reclamation, warm settlement lights fighting back endless winter."
